thread:
jess: small production spike — noticed a tenant lost scoped route quotas after we rolled back a role change that had been previewed in dry-run.

noah: can you summarize repro?

jess: repro: create role binding with `scope=payments` + `quota_override=true`; canary at 5% with dry-run ON; later flip canary off and click rollback -> authz patch omitted the `quota_override` key, router emitted `missing_scope=true` and traffic went to fallback.

vikram: looks like frontend was trimming falsey keys during preview. rollback does a replace. backend assumed absent == preserve. mismatch.

olivia: quick mitigation: frontend should always send `flags:{quota_override:true|false}` on rollback. backend can honor a new `X-Perm-Digest` header to decide replace vs preserve.

noah: agree. add telemetry event `perm.rollback_executed` sampled 1% with `route_count` and `perm_diff_hash` to correlate with router alerts.

rbac-bot: note created /incidents/perm-rollback-dryrun-mismatch tag=perm-rollback-risk.

jess: action items: @vikram patch client to include explicit flags; @noah add Grafana alert `router.events{missing_scope=\"true\"}` > 3/5m; @olivia add rollback copy explaining dry-run caveat. timeline: client PR today, server shim tomorrow.

vikram: will post PR link when ready.
